items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, Scandinavian modern farmhouse style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, high detail. Palette: white oak, cream, warm white walls, sage green, brass and black metal accents, soft natural daylight. A dining room with a round oak dining table for six and cream upholstered chairs, a brass and frosted glass chandelier hanging centered above the table at a sensible height with the bottom well above head height of seated people, a large window with sheer curtains, a sideboard with a plant. Wide view, the chandelier is clearly in proportion to the table, about half to two thirds of the table width.
